name: Floreal ~Suki Suki Daisuki~
original_name: フロレアール ～すきすきだいすき～
source:
Jean Rotard is a lighthouse guard. He lives with a maid girl Merne for many years now. But Merne heart would spreads fracture by fracture with each day - should she involve Jean to heal her heart wound?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
让·罗塔尔是一名灯塔看守人，多年来一直与女仆少女梅尔娜共同生活。然而梅尔娜的心一天比一天更加破碎。她是否应该把让牵扯进来，请他治愈自己心中的伤口？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-july-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
